title: Normalized stalk towers for the finite reductions
statement: Let X be Noetherian, A a commutative Noetherian ring and J an ideal. Let M over the completed coefficient ring be locally derived complete, with residue the comparison of a bounded etale A/J-complex C with lisse finite-type cohomology and Tor amplitude [a,b], a <= b, using exactly the hypotheses and coefficient models of [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. The ring A is not assumed J-complete. There is a coefficient-small covering family V_i of the final object, each affine and weakly contractible on its actual slice, and for each member a normalized algebraic residue tower T_i of [def-sfb-adic-residue-algebra-tower], such that c_(V_i,n)(T_i.level n) is isomorphic to the actual local derived reduction of M for every n. No base-ring perfect complex, reconstruction, or compatible local markings are asserted.

proof.text: Use the constant/completed coefficient equivalence on X to obtain the complete constant-coefficient complex N with its specified scalar-restriction isomorphism. Identify its residue with the given C using finiteDerivedComparison. Convert lisse cohomology to constructibility, and replace an unordered cohomological interval [c,d] by [min(c,d),d]. Apply the finite-reduction theorem globally to obtain C_n, alpha_n, beta_n, common Tor amplitude and constructibility, with C_0 equal to C.

Apply the finite-etale geometric stalk-level theorem to C_n and its consecutive beta maps. This supplies the affine weakly contractible cover, algebraic levels E_n, perfect residue and the consecutive scalar-extension isomorphisms. No restriction of a complete complex or its Roos triangle is needed.

Assemble the algebraic tower with canonical derived scalar left adjoints and their adjunctions. Define each transition as the adjoint transpose of the supplied algebraic step isomorphism. The inverse hom-equivalence sends the transition back to that isomorphism, proving normalization. To identify each actual local reduction, combine the finite-etale constant marking with alpha_n, the constant/completed finite comparison, and commutation of derived scalar extension with exact slice restriction. Prove the last comparison using a K-flat resolution, preservation of K-flatness on the slice, the two universal derived-extension comparison isomorphisms, and the ordinary change-of-scalars/over-complex isomorphism.

theorem adicResidue_stalk_tower_family
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (J : Ideal A)
    (M : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.D
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J))
    (_hcomplete : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.projection (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A
        J 0) M)
    (C : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.D
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0))
    (_hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q →
      IsZero ((adicResidueCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)
          q).obj C))
    (_hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (A ⧸ J ^ (0 + 1))
      ((adicResidueCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)
          q).obj C))
    (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (_htor : ∀ P : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Cx
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        (R := CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite
          (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0) P →
      Nonempty ((CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Q
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)).obj P ≅ C) →
      ∀ (N : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Mod
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0))
        (q : ℤ), q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero (adicResidueTensorCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
          (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
            A J 0) P N q))
    (_hres : Nonempty
      ((CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.extend
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.projection (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
          A J 0)).obj M ≅
        (adicResidueComparison.{u, v} X (A ⧸ J ^ (0 + 1))).obj C)) :
    ∃ (I : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (V : I → coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
      (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶
        (AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X).obj (⊤_ X.ProEt)),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X _ ∧
      ∀ i : I,
        IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
          (V i)).left ∧
        AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X (V i) ∧
        ∃ T : AdicResidueAlgebraTower J,
          ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
            ((adicResidueFiniteConstant.{u, v} X J (V i) n).obj (T.level n) ≅
              (adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J (V i) n).obj
                ((adicResidueRestriction
                  (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.completed
                    (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J) (V i)).obj M))
